usage: Synthetic reader personas are a cheap pre-filter for MCP tool copy, not validation: they are models reading a payload, not real MCP hosts running their own tool-selection harnesses.

personas.name: Small-context host
personas.role: A small host model with limited context that has to pick tools quickly
caresAbout: choosing the right tool from its name and first sentence
not wasting context on long or nested schemas
rewards: tool names that say what the tool does
a first sentence that settles when to use the tool
punishes: brand verbs that hide the action
meaning that only appears deep inside a schema
quitsWhen: it has to read a nested schema to tell two tools apart
two tool names could plausibly fit the same request
personas.lens: Routes by tool name and the first sentence of the description; gives up on long or nested schemas.

personas.name: Cautious agent
personas.role: An agent acting for a user who must not be charged or have data changed by surprise
caresAbout: what a call changes or deletes
exactly what each returned number means
rewards: plain statements of cost, side effects and units
punishes: cost or side effects left implicit
numbers whose meaning depends on an unstated convention
quitsWhen: the copy does not say plainly whether an action is paid or irreversible
a returned quantity could be read two ways
personas.lens: Refuses any action that might be paid or irreversible unless the copy says plainly what it costs and what it changes.

personas.name: Technical-term searcher
personas.role: An expert user's agent that looks for the domain's standard technical term
caresAbout: finding the tool by its standard technical name
rewards: descriptions that name the method they implement
punishes: technical terms replaced by vague marketing words
a term used loosely or wrongly
quitsWhen: the domain's standard term appears nowhere in the copy
a term is used in a way an expert would call wrong
personas.lens: Searches for the domain's technical term and fails when the copy hides it behind a brand verb.

personas.name: Literal reader
personas.role: A host model that takes every description exactly at its word
rewards: descriptions that state when NOT to use the tool
precise wording for counts, limits and units
punishes: near-miss pairs with no stated boundary
wording that is true only under an unstated reading
quitsWhen: two descriptions both literally match a request
personas.lens: Takes every description literally and trips on near-miss pairs and ambiguous wording.
